snippet.title: Castlevania - Symphony Of Horrors - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: DISCORD SERVER IN PINNED COMMENT! The home stretch is here. I've been using this project as a learning experience so I can learn how to program and be a game Dev myself. It's something I used to dabble in when I was in my high school days what I have long since grown out of practice. I chose to go with this Castlevania reimagining because I love the series and I found Simon's quest to be one of my favorite games ever growing up. I wanted to give it an overhaul in my image like I think it deserves and now here we are at the end goal. when this project is finished I'm going to use everything I've learned to make my own original project. this Castlevania game will always be free so long as it's allowed to exist. I am not affiliated with Konami in any way and everything in this game is their property.
